name: Calibre-web
tagline: Web app for browsing, reading and downloading eBooks stored in a Calibre database
description: Calibre-web is a web app providing a clean interface for browsing, reading and downloading eBooks using an existing Calibre database. It is also possible to integrate google drive and edit metadata and your calibre library through the app itself.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  calibre-web:
    environment:
      DOCKER_MODS: ghcr.io/linuxserver/mods:universal-calibre
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
    image: linuxserver/calibre-web:0.6.24
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 8083
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Media/Books
        target: /books
    container_name: calibre-web
